announcements.title: Recent announcements
announcements.empty: No announcements in the last two weeks.

note.outside_term: Today is outside this course's term dates, so there's no current week.
note.no_materials_this_week: There are no modules or materials for this week.

note.break: It's a break week. These are the materials of the week before it.

timeline.title: Where this course is now

confidence.high: This is very likely right. The clues are listed below.
confidence.medium: This is a good estimate, but check that it looks right.
confidence.low: We couldn't work this out reliably. Setting the term dates below fixes that.

timeline.evidenceEmpty: No clues yet. Sync this course or set its term dates.
timeline.outsideTerm: Today is outside this course's term dates. If the term is running, check the dates below.

term.description: {{product}} counts teaching weeks from the first day of term.
term.breaksNote: Reading weeks and breaks aren't taken into account yet.

deadlines.note: These are titles and dates only. {{product}} never downloads assignment instructions to solve them.
deadlines.pastEmpty: Nothing was due in the last {{days}} days.

empty.title: Nothing due in the next {{days}} days
empty.description: Deadlines come from Canvas or your calendar feed. If something is missing, check your sources.

policy.title: How can you use AI in this course?
policy.explanation: Your AI app sees this setting. With “{{prohibited}}”, it can still help you plan around deadlines, but it won't read this course's materials. With “{{unknown}}”, it sticks to explaining concepts.
policy.noteLabel: Paste the rule from your syllabus (optional)
policy.noteHelp: Your AI app sees this note too, so it can follow the exact wording.

settings.title: Course settings
settings.hideDescription: Hidden courses are skipped in your course list and never shown to your AI app.
settings.hiddenToast: {{course}} is hidden. Your AI app won't see it.
settings.shownToast: {{course}} is back in your course list.

aiAccess.label: Let my AI app read this course's materials

note.readable: When you ask about this course, your AI app can read its materials.
note.turned_off: Your AI app can still see deadlines and course structure, but not the materials.
note.withheld_by_policy: You marked this course “No AI”, so its materials aren't shared with your AI app. Change the AI policy to share them.

aiAccess.nowOn: Your AI app can now read this course's materials
aiAccess.nowOff: Your AI app will no longer read this course's materials

download.callout_one: {{count}} file here isn't downloaded yet, so your AI app can't read it.
download.callout_other: {{count}} files here aren't downloaded yet, so your AI app can't read them.
download.calloutHint: “Download files…” at the top of the page downloads all of this course's files.
download.viewingNotice: Downloading files through Canvas can count as viewing them (e.g. module 'must view' requirements).
download.dialogDetail: {{product}} downloads the course's files to this computer and extracts their text. Nothing is submitted or changed in Canvas.

notRead.title: What {{product}} didn't read
notRead.asOf: {{product}} last read this course in full {{when}}.

home.locked: This course's Home page is locked in Canvas, so {{product}} has only its title.

lists.pages: This course doesn't show its Pages list in Canvas. {{product}} found the pages that its modules and links point to; it can't see any others.
lists.files: This course doesn't show its Files list in Canvas. {{product}} found the files that its modules and links point to; it can't see any others.
lists.both: This course doesn't show its Pages and Files lists in Canvas. {{product}} found the pages and files that its modules and links point to; it can't see any others.

notRead.linkedNote: Pages and files found through links may not appear under a week above.

notRead.download_other: {{count}} files in this course aren't downloaded yet.
notRead.onlyNever: Only the parts {{product}} never reads, such as assignments, quizzes and grades.
notRead.mustView: A module asks you to view these pages. {{product}} reads each one at the next full sync after you've viewed it in Canvas; reading it for you could mark it as viewed.
notRead.mustViewLink: A link that could open such a page
notRead.failedNote: They're tried again on the next full sync.

failed.pagesAll: This course's pages: {{product}} couldn't check which ones a module asks you to view, so it read none of them this time.

notRead.lockedPages: Locked in Canvas. {{product}} has only their titles.
notRead.tooLarge_one: {{count}} file is too large to download.
notRead.tooLarge_other: {{count}} files are too large to download.
notRead.pastLimit: {{product}} opens a limited number of links in each course and doesn't follow links from a linked page. These are beyond that. Some are reached by a later sync; most are not.
notRead.cutShort: {{product}} read these, but they hold more links than it looks at in one text; it left the rest of them:
